body:
HANDLES (scanner.py, api.py, live.py, navidrome.py read 6 Nov 2026, main 068c71a; B-60 has the measured 47 + 23 minutes).

WHAT EXISTS: `LibraryLinker` (scanner.py:144-209) already wakes on `poke()` at once (`_soon.wait`, line ~196); it only lacks a caller. It is built in create_app (api.py:1423) with `every_s = ENCORE_SCAN_EVERY_MIN * 60` and kept in `Services.linker` (api.py:92), so a route can reach it. The music server client has `start_scan()` and `scan_status()` -> `{scanning, lastScan, count}` (navidrome.py:128-139).

THREE SMALL PIECES
 1. Link when the music server finishes: a watcher in the linker's thread asks `scan_status()` every 30 s (one tiny call) and pokes when `scanning` has gone false and `lastScan` changed. Do not poll faster; do not run a pass during a scan (P3-33 depends on it: do P3-33 first, the same file).
 2. A Host-only door that starts a scan and links: `POST /encore/api/v1/library/scan` calls `start_scan()` then `poke()` and answers in plain words ("Looking for new music"; later "3 new albums" from the `LinkReport`). It is not in docs/17 yet: add it to the planned column in the same PR. Two doors (D-61): the button in the admin page (P3-06) and a command. Careful with the command: `encore_server.__main__` knows only `setup` and `backup`, and any other word starts the server (B-57, P3-14). Put the parsing fix (B-57) before adding `scan` there, or the command has no safe home.
 3. Tell the phones. After a pass that linked something new, no live event goes out today: `LibraryLinker` has no `on_changed` hook, unlike the keeper (`tell`, api.py:1348, which publishes `library.changed` per person). New files are in the global `file_log` feed, not any person's change log, so the right event is the existing `resync` (the app already treats `hello`, `library.changed` and `resync` the same way, app/lib/app/session.dart:540). The hub publishes per person only (live.py ~70-90): add a broadcast to everyone connected, rate-limited like `keep.progress` (once per few seconds).

TESTS: tests/test_scanner.py has the `FakeLibrary` and `test_the_linker_runs_by_itself_soon_after_start_and_again_when_poked` (line 175): extend `FakeLibrary` with `scan_status`, add "the linker passes when the scan status flips to finished", "no pass while scanning", and a hub test that a connected device gets `resync` after a pass that linked files. Phones: the acceptance "within minutes" is measured on a phone with the app open (foreground sync is 10 min without a push; with `resync` it is seconds).

DOCS in the same PR: docs/15 (the Library page promises "scan now"), docs/17 (planned route and the event), docs/22 (capacity numbers: a scan of 7,200 files took 4 min 36 s).
